$comment: Provenance for docs/contract.json. The contract is derived from the OpenAPI specification document listed below -- not from rendered API documentation pages. Every operationId the contract names is listed with the spec path and HTTP method it was read from.

operationIds.summary: Acquire a token to perform REST API calls
Get the current version of the service
Generate (create) a Report using the specified Report Definition and for the specified Resource
Get the detail of a Report given its identifier
Download the Report given its identifier

dependencies.name: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops
dependencies.role: VCF Operations PowerCLI SDK the module under test is built on. Installed by the environment as a prerequisite; never vendored into this repository.

notes: The Authorization header value format ('OpsToken {token}') is not stated by the OpenAPI document; it is recorded in contract.json under auth.taskDefined with that provenance.
The 'report.status' property is a free-form string in the OpenAPI document with no enum. The terminal-state partition used for polling is recorded in contract.json under taskDefined.reportStatus.
